overall_reason: "Deal again" is a showpiece the visitor starts on purpose: it deals the site cards in on a 720 ms spring with a 30 ms stagger, so the sweep's duration, travel and layout hits on it are fitting; the page declares its own motion tokens (--ease, --ease-out, --ease-spring, --dur 320 ms, --dur-fast 160 ms), the hero copy rises once at load, and the copy button confirms with a check.

score.reason: T-PURPOSE, T-FREQUENCY and T-MOTION-SYSTEM pass on a token-based system with a chosen showpiece; T-MOTION-SYSTEM also finds the spring curve on 14 hover elements and the copy check, one drift.

findings.title: The curve fits the direction and the scope
findings.evidence: The declared transitions put cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.35, 0.5, 1), which overshoots to y 1.35, on 14 elements at 320 ms for transform and shadow, and on the copy-button check (scale from 0.4, measured overshoot 1.067). The sweep's MOT-001 hit records the overshoot curve.
findings.before: The spring curve meant for the card deal also drives hover and copy feedback.
findings.after: Keep --ease-spring for the "Deal again" showpiece and use --ease-out at --dur-fast (160 ms) for hover and the copy confirmation.
findings.why: Overshoot on small, repeated UI feedback reads as wobble; the spring earns its place only on the showpiece.

strengths: "Deal again" is a visitor-started showpiece: six cards arrive on a 720 ms spring with a 30 ms step (120 ms spread), and under reduced motion the deal does not move at all (move 0 px).
A declared motion system: three named curves and two durations as tokens, with --ease (cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1)) on 93 elements.
The hero copy rises once at load (rise, 760 ms, 12 px, delayed 0, 70 and 140 ms on three blocks), one page arrival.
The agent tabs ("Codex") change their command list with a 300 ms filter fade and no travel.
not_investigated: T-POSTER: the reduced-motion and still screenshots show the dealt cards in place, so the deal has a held result; passes
1 iframe on the page: transitions inside it were not exercised
.reveal class on scroll: ROB-001 records 73% of text hidden if IntersectionObserver never fires; scroll reveals were not recorded
the "Deal again" live run was still moving at 1479 ms with 4 ambient movers; the deal's own end time is not separable from them
no 00-contract.md in the run: visitor mode inferred from the screenshots
no passive recording (capture.mjs --passive not run): load motion and loops judged from declared animations only, not from frames
interruptibility and rapid toggles (T-RAPID-TOGGLE): no detector built
scroll-driven and scroll-revealed motion beyond the load: the capture does not scroll while recording
hover as it plays: only the declared transitions are read
route and page transitions: not captured
T-DEMO-LOOP: no looping demo on the page
